mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS shows a positive 3-month trend, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market with aggressive monetary tightening, which increases recession risk and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market near full employment generates wage pressures and inflation, prompting Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO shows a positive 3-month trend, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing market, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1200.0 for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO annual growth > 2.0%), supply chain bottlenecks ease and manufacturing output expands, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO annual growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong demand and supply coordination, signaling robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS and INDPRO both rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
